page.title: Account security
page.description: Add two-factor authentication with an authenticator app (TOTP).
page.cardHint: You enter a 6-digit code from the app every time you sign in.
page.disableHint: Confirm with your password to turn it off.
page.newCodesHint: The old backup codes stop working.
page.required: Your account holds a role that requires two-factor authentication. Turn it on before using the rest of the system.
page.cannotDisable: Cannot turn off — your role requires two-factor, or the password is wrong.

setup.passwordHint: Confirm your password to start the setup.
setup.step1: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy …) and scan this QR code.
setup.step2: Keep the backup codes somewhere safe, then enter the 6-digit code from the app to confirm.
setup.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.manual: Or type this key into the app
setup.backupHint: Each works once if you lose the app. Shown only now.
setup.codeNeeded: Type the 6-digit code from your app first

challenge.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.backupHint: Enter a backup code you have not used yet.
challenge.label: Verification code
challenge.invalid: The code is wrong or expired
